body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Panasonic(www.panasonic.com) introduced 4-inch mini Tablet PC which can connect with TV at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
4-inch mini Tablet PC of Panasonic will offer Crowd Service connected with TV. It was differentiated from over 7-inch Tablets and can be used as TV romote control.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
